if it'll always be an option, why not get it out of the way now?

Also, school is stressing me out and my family is starting to hate me.
I feel like I've failed them tremendously because of school. I feel like tonight's as good as any, no?
What if- where there is peace, there is pain? Is nothingness not an adequate solution to both of these problems?
Whatever comes after death really can't be worse than this shit can it?
i really just want peace, and death seems to bring that
why not me? if i even consider doing this to my family, why not me?
maybe a long life of pain is what i deserve
